source_universe: All 13 exercise articles in the downloaded DMOI3 section 1.2 HTML snapshot
author: Oscar Levin
rules: Preserve original rendered question, including every subpart and prerequisite context
No generated parameter changes, difficulty selection, or AXIOM-parser-based eligibility
Require a bijection to assignments under the existing DSL: at most 8 variables, 20 values per domain, 1000000 assignments, 40 supported constraints
Exclude proof requests, symbolic expansion targets, essential diagrams, and incomplete context
Exclude mixed targets or multi-question exercises unless every requested quantity is a supported count; no cherry-picking subparts
Store all exclusions with reasons; AI compatibility decisions remain provisional until independent human review
Do not show proposed mappings, answers, model outputs or audit decisions to annotators
All candidates are Development only, never official Held-out
No new model calls or effectiveness evaluation before independent Gold is frozen
fallback: One qualified independent reviewer permits only a separately disclosed single-reviewer pilot; zero reviewers blocks evaluation
